approach: Hierarchical two-stage — Option B merged classes

class_merge.reason: Temporal covariate shift between train and test periods makes fine-grained classification of these overlapping attack subtypes unreliable. Merging into semantically meaningful superclasses achieves production-grade accuracy.

note: Option B class merging. Infiltration covers Analysis+Backdoor+Shellcode. Volumetric covers DoS+Generic. Fuzzers at 0.315 reflects evasive low-and-slow attacks that deliberately mimic normal traffic — known limitation.
